## Code Chunk

```{r}
# R code goes here
diamonds <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chrdonovan-hub/64060_cdonova2/main/Assignment_1/diamonds.csv")
head(diamonds)

summary(diamonds)
```

```{r}
library(psych)
describe(diamonds[, c("price", "carat", "depth", "table", "x", "y", "z")])

# Cut quality
table(diamonds$cut)

# Color
table(diamonds$color)

# Clarity
table(diamonds$clarity)

# Install if not already installed
if (!require("psych", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("psych")
}
library(psych)

library(dplyr)

diamonds %>%
  group_by(cut) %>%
  summarize(
    Count = n(),
    Mean_Price = mean(price),
    Median_Price = median(price),
    Std_Dev = sd(price),
    Min_Price = min(price),
    Max_Price = max(price)
  )

```

![]() \# Box plot of price by cut boxplot(diamonds\$price \~ diamonds\$cut, main = "Diamond Price by Cut Quality", xlab = "Cut", ylab = "Price")
